info.name: Solaris Zones Zone Manager API
info.description:
Operations tagged Zone Manager across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: solaris-rad-zonemgr-openapi.yml, solaris-zones-management-openapi.yml. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

Contact Support:
 Name: Oracle Solaris Support
 Email: solaris-support@oracle.com
